adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger sat but completion swapped on->quietly, hypothesis predicts collapse with no predictable continuation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She decided to carry on despite the heavy rain.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same surface token on but without the selecting trigger sat, hypothesis predicts no retrospective collocation fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I would love a quiet cup of tea this morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same token would but with no selecting announced-she context and low predictability, predicts inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He tripped and fell awkwardly, bruising his knee badly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger fell but completion swapped to->awkwardly so the memorized fell->to collocation is absent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Not every rumor turns out to be true in the end.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same token not in sentence-initial unpredictable position with no pleaded trigger, predicts inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She rushed to catch the last morning bus downtown.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same token rushed but triggered by she instead of wind, breaking the claimed wind->rushed collocation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He follows his younger brother everywhere around school.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same token follows in the stalk-someone sense with no theorem-like trigger, testing sense specificity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The final score was 11 to 9 after long overtime play.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Bare digits resembling 11 without the Apollo or galaxy plus space trigger, testing trigger requirement.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The senator announced she might decline another term entirely.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Trigger announced-she kept but completion swapped would->might, hypothesis predicts replacing completion collapses activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The cat sat, tired and hungry after the journey, on the mat.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Trigger sat and completion on present but separated beyond the 1-3 token window, predicts graded down or inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: On Tuesday morning the committee reviewed several new proposals.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Completion-like token On in sentence-initial unpredictable position with no selecting verb, testing position dependence.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all criminal charges.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel pleaded->not collocation explicitly named by hypothesis in an unseen legal context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: From these axioms the main corollary follows without further argument.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel theorem-like trigger with follows as predictable continuation in unseen mathematical wording.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The exhausted hiker perched on a mossy rock at dawn.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel perched->on paraphrase of sat->on testing generalization to synonymous selecting verbs.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The mayor confirmed she would veto the budget proposal tomorrow.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel confirmed-she->would paraphrase of announced-she->would testing trigger synonym generalization.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: In 1977 Voyager 2 launched toward the outer planets.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel spacecraft plus space-digit collocation analogous to Apollo 11 in an unseen Voyager context.
